// Isolated characterization harness. Copy as described by run-sdk-probe.ps1.
// Every endpoint is intercepted. Only synthetic tokens; never prints keys.
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:atproto_oauth/atproto_oauth.dart';
import 'package:bluesky/bluesky.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:http/testing.dart';

const did = 'did:plc:fixtureperson';
const issuer = 'https://auth.example.com';
const callback = 'com.example.app:/callback';
const scope = 'atproto repo:app.bsky.feed.post?action=create';
const metadata = OAuthClientMetadata(
  clientId: 'https://app.example.com/client.json',
  applicationType: 'native',
  clientName: 'Synthetic probe',
  clientUri: 'https://app.example.com',
  grantTypes: ['authorization_code', 'refresh_token'],
  redirectUris: [callback],
  responseTypes: ['code'],
  scope: scope,
  tokenEndpointAuthMethod: 'none',
);

void check(bool value, String label) {
  if (!value) throw StateError(label);
}

Future<void> rejects(Future<Object?> Function() action, String label) async {
  var rejected = false;
  try {
    await action();
  } catch (_) {
    rejected = true;
  }
  check(rejected, label);
}

Future<void> rejectsNonce(
  Future<Object?> Function() action,
  String label,
) async {
  try {
    await action();
  } catch (error) {
    check(
      error is http.ClientException &&
          error.message == 'DPoP response nonce required',
      label,
    );
    return;
  }
  throw StateError(label);
}

Map<String, dynamic> jwtPart(String proof, int part) => jsonDecode(
  utf8.decode(base64Url.decode(base64Url.normalize(proof.split('.')[part]))),
) as Map<String, dynamic>;

class Identity implements IdentityResolver {
  @override
  Future<ResolvedIdentity> resolve(String identity) async =>
      const ResolvedIdentity(
        did: did,
        pds: 'https://pds.example.com',
        handle: 'person.example.com',
      );
}

class States implements OAuthStateStore {
  final json = <String, String>{};
  Completer<void>? pause;
  Completer<void>? started;
  @override
  Future<void> set(String key, OAuthContext value) async {
    started?.complete();
    await pause?.future;
    json[key] = jsonEncode(value.toJson());
  }

  @override
  Future<OAuthContext?> find(String key) async =>
      json[key] == null ? null : OAuthContext.fromJson(jsonDecode(json[key]!));
  @override
  Future<void> delete(String key) async {
    json.remove(key);
  }
}

class Sessions implements OAuthSessionStore {
  final json = <String, String>{};
  Completer<void>? pause;
  Completer<void>? started;
  bool fail = false;
  @override
  Future<void> set(String key, OAuthSession value) async {
    if (!(started?.isCompleted ?? true)) started!.complete();
    await pause?.future;
    if (fail) throw StateError('Synthetic storage failure');
    json[key] = jsonEncode(value.toJson());
  }

  @override
  Future<OAuthSession?> find(String key) async =>
      json[key] == null ? null : OAuthSession.fromJson(jsonDecode(json[key]!));
  @override
  Future<void> delete(String key) async {
    json.remove(key);
  }
}

/// Candidate HTTP policy only. Not a complete OAuth adapter or runtime code.
class NoncePolicy extends http.BaseClient {
  NoncePolicy(this.inner);
  final http.Client inner;
  @override
  Future<http.StreamedResponse> send(http.BaseRequest request) async {
    final response = await inner.send(request);
    final signed = request.headers.keys.any(
      (key) => key.toLowerCase() == 'dpop',
    );
    final nonce = response.headers.entries
        .where((entry) => entry.key.toLowerCase() == 'dpop-nonce')
        .map((entry) => entry.value)
        .firstOrNull;
    if (signed && (nonce == null || nonce.trim().isEmpty)) {
      await response.stream.drain<void>();
      throw http.ClientException('DPoP response nonce required');
    }
    return response;
  }
}

class RejectDiscovery extends http.BaseClient {
  RejectDiscovery(this.inner);
  final http.Client inner;
  @override
  Future<http.StreamedResponse> send(http.BaseRequest request) async {
    if (request.url.path == '/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server') {
      throw http.ClientException('Synthetic discovery policy rejection');
    }
    return inner.send(request);
  }
}

class Server {
  bool includeNonce = true;
  String responseNonce = 'synthetic-nonce';
  bool nonceChallenges = true;
  bool absentServerMetadata = false;
  bool apiChallenge = true;
  String tokenType = 'DPoP';
  String tokenSub = did;
  int pars = 0, codes = 0, refreshes = 0, apiCalls = 0;
  String? state, challenge;
  Completer<void>? tokenPause;
  Completer<void>? secondCode;
  final proofs = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  late final http.Client transport = MockClient(handle);

  http.Response json(Object body, {int status = 200, bool dpop = false}) =>
      http.Response(
        jsonEncode(body),
        status,
        headers: {
          'content-type': 'application/json',
          if (dpop && includeNonce) 'dpop-nonce': responseNonce,
        },
      );

  Future<http.Response> handle(http.Request request) async {
    final uri = request.url;
    check(uri.scheme == 'https', 'No HTTP endpoints in fixture');
    if (uri.path.startsWith('/xrpc/'))
      return apiGet(uri, headers: request.headers);
    if (uri.path == '/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource') {
      return json({
        'resource': 'https://pds.example.com',
        'authorization_servers': [issuer],
      });
    }
    if (uri.path == '/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server') {
      if (absentServerMetadata) return json({'error': 'missing'}, status: 404);
      return json({
        'issuer': issuer,
        'authorization_endpoint': '$issuer/oauth/authorize',
        'token_endpoint': '$issuer/oauth/token',
        'pushed_authorization_request_endpoint': '$issuer/oauth/par',
        'require_pushed_authorization_requests': true,
        'response_types_supported': ['code'],
        'grant_types_supported': ['authorization_code', 'refresh_token'],
        'code_challenge_methods_supported': ['S256'],
        'dpop_signing_alg_values_supported': ['ES256'],
        'authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported': true,
        'token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported': ['none'],
        'scopes_supported': [scope],
      });
    }
    final proof = request.headers['dpop'];
    check(proof != null, 'SDK must sign every OAuth POST');
    check(jwtPart(proof!, 0)['alg'] == 'ES256', 'Package-owned ES256');
    final claims = jwtPart(proof, 1);
    check(claims['htu'] == '${uri.origin}${uri.path}', 'DPoP target binding');
    check(claims['htm'] == request.method, 'DPoP method binding');
    proofs.add(claims);
    if (uri.path == '/oauth/par') {
      pars++;
      final body = request.bodyFields;
      check(body['code_challenge_method'] == 'S256', 'PKCE S256 required');
      check(body['client_id'] == metadata.clientId, 'Public client ID');
      check(!body.containsKey('client_secret'), 'No shared secret');
      check(body['redirect_uri'] == callback, 'Exact redirect sent');
      state = body['state'];
      challenge = body['code_challenge'];
      if (nonceChallenges && includeNonce && pars == 1) {
        return json({'error': 'use_dpop_nonce'}, status: 400, dpop: true);
      }
      if (nonceChallenges && includeNonce)
        check(claims['nonce'] == 'synthetic-nonce', 'Nonce retry proof');
      return json(
        {
          'request_uri': 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:request_uri:fixture',
          'expires_in': 60,
        },
        status: 201,
        dpop: true,
      );
    }
    check(uri.path == '/oauth/token', 'Unexpected OAuth endpoint');
    final body = request.bodyFields;
    if (body['grant_type'] == 'authorization_code') {
      codes++;
      if (codes == 2 && !(secondCode?.isCompleted ?? true))
        secondCode!.complete();
      final encoded = base64Url
          .encode(sha256.convert(utf8.encode(body['code_verifier']!)).bytes)
          .replaceAll('=', '');
      check(encoded == challenge, 'Exchange verifier matches PAR challenge');
    } else {
      check(body['grant_type'] == 'refresh_token', 'Only refresh or code');
      refreshes++;
      check(
        body['refresh_token'] == 'synthetic-refresh-0',
        'Rotating refresh input',
      );
    }
    await tokenPause?.future;
    return json({
      'access_token': 'synthetic-access-$refreshes',
      'refresh_token': 'synthetic-refresh-$refreshes',
      'token_type': tokenType,
      'scope': scope,
      'sub': tokenSub,
      'expires_in': 3600,
    }, dpop: true);
  }

  http.Response apiResponse(Uri uri, Object body, int status) {
    final response = json(body, status: status, dpop: true);
    return http.Response(
      response.body,
      status,
      headers: response.headers,
      request: http.Request('GET', uri),
    );
  }

  Future<http.Response> apiGet(Uri uri, {Map<String, String>? headers}) async {
    apiCalls++;
    check(uri.host == 'pds.example.com', 'API bound to PDS');
    check(uri.path == '/xrpc/app.bsky.actor.getProfile', 'Expected API method');
    check(
      (headers?['Authorization'] ?? headers?['authorization']) ==
          'DPoP synthetic-access-0',
      'API token binding',
    );
    final proof = headers?['DPoP'] ?? headers?['dpop'];
    check(
      proof != null && jwtPart(proof!, 1)['ath'] != null,
      'API access token hash proof',
    );
    if (apiChallenge && apiCalls == 1)
      return apiResponse(uri, {'error': 'use_dpop_nonce'}, 401);
    if (apiChallenge)
      check(
        jwtPart(proof!, 1)['nonce'] == 'synthetic-nonce',
        'API nonce retry',
      );
    return apiResponse(uri, {'did': did, 'handle': 'person.example.com'}, 200);
  }
}

OAuthClient client(
  Server server,
  States states,
  Sessions sessions, {
  bool policy = false,
}) => OAuthClient(
  metadata,
  identityResolver: Identity(),
  stateStore: states,
  sessionStore: sessions,
  httpClient: policy ? NoncePolicy(server.transport) : server.transport,
);
String callbackUrl(Server server, {String target = callback}) =>
    Uri.parse(target)
        .replace(
          queryParameters: {
            'state': server.state!,
            'iss': issuer,
            'code': 'synthetic-code',
          },
        )
        .toString();

int passed = 0;
Future<void> scenario(String name, Future<void> Function() body) async {
  try {
    await body().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
    passed++;
    stdout.writeln('PASS $name');
  } catch (error) {
    stderr.writeln(
      'FAIL $name (${error.runtimeType}; synthetic details suppressed)',
    );
    exitCode = 1;
  }
}

Future<void> main() async {
  await scenario('package roundtrip PAR/S256/ES256 + awaited stores + API nonce + single-flight rotation + restore', () async {
    final server = Server();
    final states = States();
    final sessions = Sessions();
    final oauth = client(server, states, sessions, policy: true);
    states.pause = Completer<void>();
    states.started = Completer<void>();
    var authorized = false;
    final authorization = oauth.authorize('person.example.com').then((v) {
      authorized = true;
      return v;
    });
    await states.started!.future;
    check(
      !authorized && states.json.isEmpty,
      'Browser launch cannot precede saved state',
    );
    states.pause!.complete();
    final uri = await authorization;
    check(
      uri.host == 'auth.example.com' && server.pars == 2,
      'PAR nonce bounded retry',
    );
    check(
      server.proofs[0]['jti'] != server.proofs[1]['jti'],
      'Fresh proof on retry',
    );
    final restartedStates = States()..json.addAll(states.json);
    final restarted = client(server, restartedStates, sessions, policy: true);
    sessions.pause = Completer<void>();
    sessions.started = Completer<void>();
    var connected = false;
    final exchange = restarted.callback(callbackUrl(server)).then((v) {
      connected = true;
      return v;
    });
    await sessions.started!.future;
    check(
      !connected && sessions.json.isEmpty,
      'Connection waits for session persistence',
    );
    sessions.pause!.complete();
    final session = await exchange;
    check(
      restartedStates.json.isEmpty && session.sub == did,
      'State consumed, account bound',
    );
    final manager = OAuthSessionManager.fromSession(session, client: restarted);
    final bsky = Bluesky.fromOAuth(
      manager,
      getClient: NoncePolicy(server.transport).get,
    );
    final profile = await bsky.actor.getProfile(actor: did);
    check(
      profile.data.did == did && server.apiCalls == 2,
      'Compatible Bluesky SDK API nonce retry',
    );
    sessions.pause = Completer<void>();
    sessions.started = Completer<void>();
    var rotated = false;
    final rotations =
        Future.wait([restarted.refresh(session), restarted.refresh(session)])
            .then((v) {
              rotated = true;
              return v;
            });
    await sessions.started!.future;
    check(
      !rotated && server.refreshes == 1,
      'Refresh serialized and persistence awaited',
    );
    sessions.pause!.complete();
    final replacements = await rotations;
    check(
      replacements.every((s) => s.accessToken == 'synthetic-access-1'),
      'Same rotation result',
    );
    final restored = await client(
      server,
      States(),
      Sessions()..json.addAll(sessions.json),
    ).restore(did);
    check(
      restored?.refreshToken == 'synthetic-refresh-1',
      'Serialized restart restores rotated session',
    );
  });
  await scenario(
    'session store failure rejects callback and consumes state',
    () async {
      final server = Server();
      final states = States();
      final sessions = Sessions()..fail = true;
      final oauth = client(server, states, sessions);
      await oauth.authorize(did);
      await rejects(
        () => oauth.callback(callbackUrl(server)),
        'Must reject failed persistence',
      );
      check(
        states.json.isEmpty && sessions.json.isEmpty,
        'No connected session after write failure',
      );
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'SDK rejects wrong issuer and wrong account before persistence',
    () async {
      for (final wrongIssuer in [true, false]) {
        final server = Server();
        final states = States();
        final sessions = Sessions();
        final oauth = client(server, states, sessions);
        await oauth.authorize(did);
        if (!wrongIssuer) server.tokenSub = 'did:plc:otherfixture';
        final url = wrongIssuer
            ? Uri.parse(callbackUrl(server))
                  .replace(
                    queryParameters: {
                      'state': server.state!,
                      'iss': 'https://other.example.com',
                      'code': 'synthetic-code',
                    },
                  )
                  .toString()
            : callbackUrl(server);
        await rejects(() => oauth.callback(url), 'Binding must reject');
        check(sessions.json.isEmpty, 'No account mismatch saved');
      }
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'characterization: raw SDK accepts missing response nonce',
    () async {
      final server = Server()..includeNonce = false;
      await client(server, States(), Sessions()).authorize(did);
      check(server.pars == 1, 'Observed missing nonce acceptance');
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'candidate policy rejects missing response nonce before state save',
    () async {
      for (final nonce in <String?>[null, '', ' ']) {
        final server = Server()
          ..includeNonce = nonce != null
          ..responseNonce = nonce ?? ''
          ..nonceChallenges = false;
        final states = States();
        await rejectsNonce(
          () => client(server, states, Sessions(), policy: true).authorize(did),
          'Mandatory nonce candidate',
        );
        check(states.json.isEmpty, 'Rejected response cannot save flow');
      }
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'characterization: raw SDK accepts wrong callback target',
    () async {
      final server = Server();
      final states = States();
      final sessions = Sessions();
      final oauth = client(server, states, sessions);
      await oauth.authorize(did);
      final session = await oauth.callback(
        callbackUrl(server, target: 'wrong.app:/other'),
      );
      check(
        session.sub == did && server.codes == 1,
        'Observed target validation gap',
      );
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'characterization: raw SDK accepts Bearer token type',
    () async {
      final server = Server()..tokenType = 'Bearer';
      final states = States();
      final oauth = client(server, states, Sessions());
      await oauth.authorize(did);
      check(
        (await oauth.callback(callbackUrl(server))).tokenType == 'Bearer',
        'Observed token type gap',
      );
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'characterization: raw SDK guesses endpoints after missing AS metadata',
    () async {
      final server = Server()..absentServerMetadata = true;
      await client(server, States(), Sessions()).authorize(did);
      check(server.pars == 2, 'Observed discovery fallback');
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'characterization: concurrent callback exchanges same state twice',
    () async {
      final server = Server()
        ..tokenPause = Completer<void>()
        ..secondCode = Completer<void>();
      final oauth = client(server, States(), Sessions());
      await oauth.authorize(did);
      final callbacks = Future.wait([
        oauth.callback(callbackUrl(server)),
        oauth.callback(callbackUrl(server)),
      ]);
      await server.secondCode!.future;
      server.tokenPause!.complete();
      await callbacks;
      check(server.codes == 2, 'Observed concurrent consume gap');
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'candidate policy rejects token response without nonce before session save',
    () async {
      final server = Server();
      final states = States();
      final sessions = Sessions();
      final oauth = client(server, states, sessions, policy: true);
      await oauth.authorize(did);
      server.includeNonce = false;
      await rejectsNonce(
        () => oauth.callback(callbackUrl(server)),
        'Token nonce required',
      );
      check(sessions.json.isEmpty, 'No missing-nonce session persisted');
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'candidate API transport rejects successful response missing nonce',
    () async {
      final server = Server()..apiChallenge = false;
      final states = States();
      final oauth = client(server, states, Sessions());
      await oauth.authorize(did);
      final session = await oauth.callback(callbackUrl(server));
      final manager = OAuthSessionManager.fromSession(session, client: oauth);
      server.includeNonce = false;
      final raw = Bluesky.fromOAuth(manager, getClient: server.apiGet);
      check(
        (await raw.actor.getProfile(actor: did)).data.did == did,
        'Observed API missing nonce acceptance',
      );
      final guarded = Bluesky.fromOAuth(
        manager,
        getClient: NoncePolicy(server.transport).get,
      );
      await rejectsNonce(
        () => guarded.actor.getProfile(actor: did),
        'API nonce policy blocks success',
      );
    },
  );
  await scenario(
    'characterization: fetched metadata may advertise a different client ID',
    () async {
      final transport = MockClient(
        (request) async => http.Response(
          jsonEncode({
            ...metadata.toJson(),
            'client_id': 'https://other.example.com/client.json',
          }),
          200,
          headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'},
          request: request,
        ),
      );
      final fetched = await getClientMetadata(
        metadata.clientId,
        client: transport,
      );
      check(
        fetched.clientId == 'https://other.example.com/client.json',
        'Observed metadata client ID gap',
      );
    },
  );
  await scenario('characterization: discovery transport rejection is swallowed into fallback', () async {
    final server = Server();
    final oauth = OAuthClient(
      metadata,
      identityResolver: Identity(),
      httpClient: RejectDiscovery(server.transport),
    );
    await oauth.authorize(did);
    check(server.pars == 2, 'Observed swallowed policy exception');
  });
  stdout.writeln(
    '$passed/13 scenarios passed; characterization gaps are NOT SDK acceptance.',
  );
}
